class.name: JarOffsetSdf
class.brief_description: Grows, shrinks or hollows its child field.
class.description: A positive [member offset] inflates the surface and rounds its edges; a negative one shrinks it. With [member shell_thickness] above [code]0[/code], only a shell around the surface remains (useful for hollow domes and pipes).

members.member: Distance to move the surface outwards (negative moves it inwards).
If greater than [code]0[/code], hollows the shape into a shell of this thickness.
